visualCharacteristics.structure: stepped scored quiz in a framed card (photo left | step counter, question, radio answers, Back/Next) + scored result message + conditional product cards carousel

contentPattern.structure: First cell = row type. Image row: [picture]. Question rows: [q1..qN] | [question text] | [ul: one li per option] | [weights, e.g. '3, 1, -3'; empty = not scored]. Result rows: [Lease | Finance] | [condition; empty = default] | [rich content]. Products row: [Products] | [heading]. Product rows: [Product] | [condition] | [picture] | [title, description, Learn More link]. Lease if sum of weights > 0 else Finance; first matching result row of that outcome is shown; every matching product row is shown. Condition: comma-separated AND clauses 'qN = k', 'qN = k or m', 'Lease', 'Finance', 'Always'; empty = always
